chunks: In the same way have their companions shown many unbelievers the killing of their children as desirable in order to ruin them and falsify their faith. If God had so willed they would never have done so. Leave them to their falsehoods.
ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of 'shuraka' leading polytheists to kill their children in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights how the polytheists' 'shuraka' (deities) distorted the natural instinct of parental love, making child sacrifice appear as a noble act of devotion to lead them astray. The phrase 'Wa Law Sha'a Allahu' is interpreted by scholars like Al-Tabarsi to indicate divine permission rather than compulsion, emphasizing human agency in their self-inflicted ruin. It concludes with the command to leave them to their fabrications, serving as a practical lesson for the faithful to remain steadfast amidst cultural distortions of monotheism.
